messages.mission.artillery-pilot.title: Artillery Trial
messages.mission.artillery-pilot.briefing.short: Fire directly with your own line of sight or indirectly with a living, active friendly spotter.

messages.mission.catalog-transport.title: Transport Line
messages.mission.catalog-transport.briefing.short: Deploy an Artillery Drone and transport infantry towards the enemy Command Core.
messages.mission.catalog-transport.budget: One drone uses the full cargo capacity. Infantry and a drone cannot be mixed.

messages.mission.catalog-maneuver.briefing.short: Try skimmer maneuvers and Amphibious Infantry along the river.
messages.mission.catalog-maneuver.budget: Use the displayed movement budgets and account for terrain costs.
